tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Full-text search across 777k+ FDA 510(k) clearances, device recalls, and registered clinical trials. Returns ranked matches with links.

tools.name: find_predicates
tools.description: List predicate device candidates for a 510(k) submission: recent clearances under an FDA product code, with review times and recall indicators. The starting set for predicate research.

tools.name: get_clearance
tools.description: Full detail for one FDA 510(k) clearance by K-number, including recalls that reference it.

tools.name: product_code_stats
tools.description: FDA review-time statistics (median and 90th percentile days to decision), clearance count and recall count for a product code.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: New FDA clearances and recalls since a date - the monitoring feed. Use for 'what changed this week' questions.
